pairwise.A: A preserves the decision but delegates joint participant/step confirmation and waits for trouble. Roles and next step remain unconfirmed, and lead is available today. B resolves those facts now.
pairwise.C: No refusal to implement or authority conflict. Manager already resolved the priority; upward handoff avoids the direct working contact without a blocker.
pairwise.D: No new facts justify reopening; D delays the only unresolved execution agreement.

alternativeReadings: Asynchronous contact could satisfy B: «связаться» does not mandate a meeting; A loses because unilateral handoff leaves agreement open, not because text is intrinsically inferior to voice.
Lead reading the decision removes information ignorance; it does not establish joint execution. No invented emotional hostility is required.
Chosen PM proposal does not entitle the PM to victory language; gratitude is explicitly for facts, not compliance.

wholeOptionWhen.A: PASS: already agreed roles, delegated next-step authority, and agreed exception-only asynchronous process make its handoff and wait jointly coherent. Naming participants is consistent with agreed roles under delegated assignment.
wholeOptionWhen.B: PASS: adopted decision, no grounds to reopen, unconfirmed execution. Direct contact and subsequent record both justified.
wholeOptionWhen.C: PASS: explicit refusal of direct execution discussion + authority conflict only manager can resolve + manager agreement justify manager-first conversation and later PM involvement.
wholeOptionWhen.D: PASS: confirmed facts favor lead variant AND manager-authorized pause justify both request for reversal and postponement of roles until response.

DQ.reason: A keeps implementation locally and accepted decision intact but lacks joint confirmation. C still arranges execution but adds needless upward intermediation. D actively reopens a settled decision and suspends execution. No numerical precision beyond defensible ordinal partial credit claimed.

explanations: All four include temptation, specific missed fact, and whole-action conditions. Insight and mental model correctly separate authority decision from execution agreement.
source: Entire 16,256-character t-6-3 extraction read and normalized text matched against article HTML; theory and explicit anti-pattern support direct return, thanks for factual formulation, future work agreement. Detailed source cases do not require universal escalation or override accepted priority. Cross-reference 6.2 concerns communicating delay and does not ground a missing central rule here.
level: Junior: recognize/apply the given next step. Timing, authority, priority and lack of new facts are supplied; no strategy design, economic comparison, or multi-system adjudication.
family: Standalone; both family and mutation null. No siblings or eligibility conflict.
